notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Plates are white or yellow, short or long, all with a blue EU strip; white ones also have a blue strip on the right. Front plates are optional.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Boxy houses made of wooden panels, often in vivid colours.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Flat or rolling grassland, with the coast usually in view.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: All coverage is from a gen 3 trekker camera.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage is only in the east of the main island and at the northern tip of the other one.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: The northern village has timber-clad houses in bold, vivid colours, and the shadow of the ATV can be seen.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: The capital was covered by a sidewalk trekker, showing larger buildings, more cars and a busier feel.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A slightly hilly, grassy landscape with boxy houses spaced apart is on the small island offshore from the capital.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The rural trekker in the far north has rolling grassland and walks a wooden path lined with trees.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The rural trekker on the main island has rockier ground and also follows a tree-lined path.
